mods.reason: The Unicorn Overlord app doesn't load mods yet.

files.label: Game app
files.summary: The Mac app MacNativeGames built for Unicorn Overlord.
files.detail: Play opens this app. It's named 圣兽之王.app, the game's Chinese name, and MacNativeGames builds it inside the work folder. The app is small: it runs the game from the work folder, so keep that folder where it is.

files.label: Base game
files.summary: Your copy of the game itself: the base game NSP you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: MacNativeGames supports only the Asian release of the game. Reading it needs the keys from your Switch.

files.label: Update
files.summary: Your copy of the game's 1.05 update: the NSP file you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: The game's code comes from this update, and MacNativeGames supports no other version.

files.label: Work folder
files.summary: The folder MacNativeGames worked in when it built the game app.
files.detail: It's ~/Games/Unicorn-build-1.05 unless you chose another folder when building. The game runs from it and writes its log, boot.log, there.
